scope: Read-only local desktop protocol inspection, no production integration. All proprietary source/disassembly remains private.

confidence_legend.PROVEN: Direct schema, response, or explicit native branch/copy evidence at recorded binary
confidence_legend.HIGH CONFIDENCE: Native semantic interpretation with supporting dataflow, not all runtime edge cases exercised
confidence_legend.MEDIUM: Partial/inferred evidence; not an implementation guarantee

facts.claim: Automix and AutomixBundle schemas are proto3. Transition service AutomationCurves minimum/maximum are fields 3/4; bundle AutomationCurves uses 2/3. Fx style request bpm is float field 2 and num_bars int32 field 3.
Current returned FX dry/wet envelopes for IDs 0..11 are identical at BPM 0/60/120/240 with four bars and at 2/4/8 bars with BPM120. This does not prove DSP effect timing independence.
Volume and EQ curves depend on numBars; historical 0/1/2 responses equal. Native materializer clamps bars 2..32.

Native materializer effective BPM per side = item_speed_side * positive metadata BPM; otherwise item_speed_side * (clamped_numBars*240/outgoing_duration_seconds), with 120 fallback when duration is not positive. Incoming fallback also uses outgoing duration.

Native preset materialization rejects an unknown preset and returns no materialized transition for NONE=0 before applying style/curve overrides; RPC unknown preset fallback is not materializer validity.
Native preset style IDs resolve first, six present style override messages replace IDs including zero. Curve override extraction requires configuration byte +0xa0.

Native volume override replaces that side. Present EQ/filter override group replaces that side group, with absent child channels becoming empty; UI display fallback differs. FX overrides apply only to channels when FX style is nonzero; otherwise ignored.
Native override conversion copies curve points and start/end unchanged and does not read AutomationCurves minimum/maximum.

Stored bundle and captured GetMixingBundle response contain identical decoded bundle data. Bundle has six presets, no FX style lists, no explicit version field, sales_period start/end int64 schema fields. Side style numeric identifiers are omitted in this snapshot.

Complete y-to-DSP mappings (gain dB/linear, filter Hz/Q/resonance, noise color and wet/dry law), Bezier runtime evaluation and out-of-range handling, style data fetch/update policy and native side-ID assignment are not established by these artifacts.

Curve override configuration byte +0xa0 is core-automix/auto_transition_use_curve_overrides, accessor 0x0048163c, compiled default false, stored by 0x00482475. Effective account override remains UNKNOWN.
